base_rate.description: While the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card does not earn rewards, it does offer benefits such as a low intro balance transfer fee, no annual fee, Citi® Flex Pay, access to Merchant Offers, free access to your FICO® Score and $0 liability on unauthorized charges.

benefits.title: No Annual Fee
benefits.description: There is no annual fee with the Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card.

benefits.title: Citi® Flex Pay
benefits.description: Pay over time with a fixed monthly payment. Available on eligible purchases of $75 or more using an eligible Citi® credit card.

benefits.title: Free Access to FICO® Score
benefits.description: Free access to your FICO® Score online to review your credit history.

benefits.title: Mastercard® ID Theft Protection
benefits.description: The ID Theft Protection program offered by Mastercard® helps eliminate the worry of identity theft by monitoring the information you choose to protect and alerting you if suspicious activity is found.

benefits.title: Citi® Quick Lock
benefits.description: Use Citi® Quick Lock in the Citi Mobile® App or at citi.com to instantly block new charges while allowing recurring transactions to continue without disruption.

benefits.title: Citi Entertainment®
benefits.description: Entertainment access program available to eligible Citi® credit card and Citibank® Debit Card customers. Special access to purchase tickets to thousands of events, including presale tickets and exclusive experiences.

benefits.title: Citi Travel®
benefits.description: With Citi Travel®, you can book flights, hotels, car rentals and attractions using your eligible Citi card. Access to over 1.4 million hotels and resorts available worldwide.

benefits.title: $0 Liability for Unauthorized Charges
benefits.description: The Citi® Diamond Preferred® Credit Card comes with all the benefits of a Citi credit card, including a payment due date of your choice, 24/7 customer service and $0 liability for unauthorized charges.

notes: Verified from official Citi product page. Annual fee confirmed as $0 from FAQ. Card does not earn rewards (stated in FAQ).
